ReactionType.NotDamaged: Takes no damage, but still reacts
ReactionType.OnlyDamageEffect: Applies damage visual effect only, no physical impulse
ReactionType.Undefined: Undefined reaction (no specific behavior, often placeholder)
ReactionType.SwayByOmniDirAt: Sways based on omnidirectional attack direction

DeathType.DieFall: Falls over and dies on the ground
DeathType.DieFallWithoutEffect: Falls over but without particle effects
DeathType.VanishWithSmoke: Vanishes in a small puff of smoke
DeathType.VanishWithSmokeHuge: Vanishes in a large puff of smoke
DeathType.ShotHorizontalWithoutEffect: Shot horizontally and dies without particle effects
DeathType.ShotUpWithoutEffect: Launched upward and dies without particle effects

DamageType.Light: Light damage, may cause instant death without effect
DamageType.ShockWaveInAir: Damage from a shockwave triggered in mid‑air

AtType.CarriedObject: Attack from a carried/thrown object (crate, barrel, etc.)

LayerSensor.AllAttack: Broader attack layer, hits multiple target types (player, items, reflectable objects)
LayerSensor.Area: Pure trigger/zone sensor (e.g., target area, no direct actor contact)
LayerSensor.CustomReceiver: Sensor with custom receiver logic (from player actors)
LayerSensor.Enemy: Pure target/tracking sensor without own damage (e.g., '_Target' hitboxes)
LayerSensor.EnemyAttack: Damages player on contact (e.g., spikes, attack hitboxes)
LayerSensor.NoHit: Sensor without own hit effect (from player actors, e.g., pure animation markers)
LayerSensor.Object: Layer for general objects (e.g., lifts, environmental objects)
LayerSensor.AllAtReceiver: Broad attack receiver layer; receives all attack types (e.g., breakable areas, balloon killers)
LayerSensor.CarriedObjectAttack: Attack layer for carried/thrown objects (crate, barrel, etc.)
LayerSensor.ChemicalBlock: Chemical block layer (e.g., gold leaf, wonder snow)

SubLayerSensor.Player_LocalHitPlayerLocal: Local player sublayer, hits other local player sensors
SubLayerSensor.Unspecified: No special sublayer specified (default for attack hitboxes)
SubLayerSensor.AreaSwitch: Area switch sublayer (e.g., race turn areas)
SubLayerSensor.BothEntityAndSensorAt: Both entity and sensor attack sublayer (e.g., fireballs)
SubLayerSensor.ObjectBlockPot: Object block pot sublayer (e.g., carried throw objects, pots)
SubLayerSensor.UpwardImpactTarget: Upward impact target sublayer (e.g., balloon killers)

EnableLayerHitMask.HitOnlyArea: Registers hits only from zone/area sensors
EnableLayerHitMask.HitOnlyEnemyTarget: Registers hits only from enemy target sensors (LayerSensor 'Enemy')
EnableLayerHitMask.HitOnlyFluid: Registers hits only from fluids (water, etc.)
EnableLayerHitMask.HitToAreaAndFluid: Registers hits from zones and fluids
EnableLayerHitMask.HitToEnemyAndObject: Registers hits from enemies and objects
EnableLayerHitMask.HitToItemAndCoin: Registers hits from items and coins
EnableLayerHitMask.ThroughObjectInGround: Ignores objects sunk in the ground
EnableLayerHitMask.HitOnlyPlayerTarget: Registers hits only from player targets (e.g., electric cloud attack)
EnableLayerHitMask.BulletFireBall: Registers hits from fireball bullet layers (e.g., fireballs, Yoshi fire)
EnableLayerHitMask.HitOnlyAllAttack: Registers hits only from all-attack layers
EnableLayerHitMask.HitOnlyChemicalBlock: Registers hits only from chemical blocks
EnableLayerHitMask.HitOnlyEnemyAttack: Registers hits only from enemy attack layers
EnableLayerHitMask.HitOnlyPlayerAttack: Registers hits only from player attack layers
EnableLayerHitMask.HitToEnemyAndObjectAndBlock: Registers hits from enemies, objects, and blocks
EnableLayerHitMask.HitToPlayerAndGround: Registers hits from players and ground
EnableLayerHitMask.HitToPlayerAndObject: Registers hits from players and objects
EnableLayerHitMask.ThroughBlockExceptChemicalBlock: Ignores blocks except chemical blocks (passes through)
EnableLayerHitMask.ThroughEnemyAndAreaAndFluid: Ignores enemies, areas, and fluids (passes through)
EnableLayerHitMask.ThroughItemAndCoinAndBlock: Ignores items, coins, and blocks (passes through)
EnableLayerHitMask.ThroughPlayerAndCarriedObject: Ignores players and carried objects (passes through)

EnableSubLayerHitMask.HitOnlyUpwardImpactTarget: Registers hits only from upward strike targets (e.g., block from below)
EnableSubLayerHitMask.PlayerLocal: Registers hits only from the local player
EnableSubLayerHitMask.HitOnlyAttackInGround: Registers hits only from attacks in the ground
EnableSubLayerHitMask.NoHit: Registers no sublayer hits (disables hit detection)
EnableSubLayerHitMask.PlayerBulletShabon: Registers hits only from player bubble bullets (e.g., BulletShabon)
EnableSubLayerHitMask.ThroughBothEntityAndSensorAt: Ignores both entity and sensor attacks (passes through)
EnableSubLayerHitMask.ThroughDokanAndBreakableObjectAll: Ignores pipes and all breakable objects (passes through)
EnableSubLayerHitMask.ThroughGelFieldAndIvy: Ignores gel fields and ivy (passes through)
EnableSubLayerHitMask.ThroughGelFieldInside: Ignores inside of gel fields (passes through)
EnableSubLayerHitMask.ThroughObjectInGround: Ignores objects in the ground (passes through)
